headline: Israeli Strikes Kill at Least Eight Palestinians in Gaza
deck: Accounts from Reuters, Al Jazeera and two other outlets reported at least eight Palestinians killed, including five police officers.
body: An Israeli drone attack killed five Palestinian police officers in al-Mawasi, west of Khan Younis, on 1 November, Al Jazeera reported. [E2]

Reuters reported that Israeli strikes killed at least eight Palestinians, including five police officers, in two attacks in Gaza that day. Xinhua and Anadolu Agency also reported eight deaths, including five police officers; Anadolu said the dead included a child and several others were wounded. [E1][E3][E4]
Anadolu Agency reported that a medical source said the attacks came amid Israel’s daily violations of last year’s ceasefire. [E4]

evidence_box.fragment: Israeli strikes killed at least eight Palestinians, including five police officers, in the Gaza Strip in two separate attacks on Sunday, according to medics and the Hamas-run interior ministry.
